item.title: Press Your Space-Face Close To Mine, Love
item.content:encoded:
I did tell you we were going to the sun.

All the credit in the world to Dr Reach for 179 and CadaverCommander for 1233!

+ I love these characters so damn much
- I hope you love them too, to an uncomfortable degree

So, uh, nobody's put these two together before? Except in that one April Fools' Day joke.

Sauelsuesor is the best thing in Series I. Have I read the entire Series? No. Do I have to? No. Honestly, I think I knew her article was the best part of the Series the moment I read it. What could be better? That's right, nothing. She's perfect, and Dr. Reach hit it wayyyy out of the park.

Moon Champion might just be the best thing in Series II. CadaverCommander also hit it out of the park. I'll get to have more fun with him (Moon Champion, not CadaverCommander) when he's on Earth, and he can do more than float around and talk funny, but hopefully this little teaser has left you completely unable to picture how our storyline's going to move forward.

It'll be more fun for me if it comes as a surprise to you.

Sauelsuesor's full name comes from this probably non-canonical but great post by Dr. Reach, and the information about her weighing rather a lot comes from this post by Ruengies_Elaj.

Special thanks to TEAM RR BEST TEAM: KaraKatt, not_a_seagull, and The Pighead, and of course to Constant Reader Grigori Karpin.

Oh, and that not-particularly-complicated sun logo is just yours truly dicking around with our existing imagery.
